Already signed up for free credits but wants quick perf proof to show investors/early customers.

- Throughput: initial beta 500 DAU, planning to scale to 5k in 6 months.
- Cost sensitivity: high; seed runway — wants predictable per-token costs and suggestions for batching/caching.
- Model preferences: open models preferred for cost control; willing to try Redwood-verified variants. Requests fallback routing to cheaper model for non-critical queries.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required for enterprise customers later; currently no SSO enforced but want roadmap for SSO/SAML and audit logs.
